title: Asahina Mafuyu — Captive Masquerade〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh boy, I can't focus anymore.
I've more or less finished this section anyway, so I'll be logging off now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm logging off too.
I really need to catch up on all that lost sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I'll do that after I find a good place to stop—>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hey. Why do you think feelings and emotions exist?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't go all quiet on us right after dropping a bomb like that just before we were about to log off!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's really unusual for you to try to start a conversation. Did something happen to make you ask that?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<There's no deep meaning to it.
I just wanted something to reference for my lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Well, I actually wonder about that myself too.
It's like, do animals really need feelings and emotions to live?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Emotions, huh.
Honestly, I find them annoying and a total pain in the neck...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, feelings like frustration can sometimes be helpful.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well... Okay, I'm not some sort of hero wannabe, but you know? Like when someone puts you down, the frustration you feel motivates you to want to do something about it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Of course! The classic spirit of defiance♪
You're so cool, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, I didn't mean it as an insult!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I think I understand what Enanan is trying to say.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Lose what? Your motivation because of achieving your goal?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No. What if you lose the ability to feel frustration?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I don't really know...
Then I guess I wouldn't be me anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yup. It's impossible for me to be me without frustration.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But you don't like to feel frustrated, do you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Excuse me? Are you looking for a fight?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sigh... I don't know what to say about you anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Nobody likes to feel frustrated... But without that feeling of frustration, I don't think I'd even be here right now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I...I don't know how to put it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'd just be a completely different Ena Shinonome, leading a completely different sort of life.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Uh... I'm not sure. Anyway, I just wouldn't be myself anymore, that's all! I know that wasn't exactly eloquent, but that's roughly the idea!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I wouldn't be myself anymore... Then maybe...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Is it just me, or did that sound really hollow?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sigh... At least you said something this time.
That's improvement.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So I guess we can call this case closed for now?>
